app.title: Live fact check
app.tagline: Check claims live while you talk
app.empty: No claims checked yet. Type a claim to get started.
config.error: The app could not load its configuration. Please reload the page.
connection.noToken: Please enter the access token in the settings first.
textmode.label: Claim
textmode.placeholder: e.g. “Der Zweite Weltkrieg ist erst 20 Jahre vorbei.”
textmode.error.rate_limited: Too many checks in a short time. Please wait a moment.
textmode.error.session_unknown: The connection was renewed. Please send again.
textmode.error.other: The claim could not be sent.
confidence.label: Confidence
reason.classified_unverifiable: Opinion, prediction, or not decidable from sources.
reason.low_confidence: The assessment was too uncertain for a verdict.
reason.budget_exceeded: The daily budget for cloud models is used up.
reason.invalid_llm_output: The model did not return a usable answer.
reason.uncited_or_foreign_source: The answer did not rely on the retrieved sources.
card.speaker: Speaker {speaker}
card.disclaimer: Automatic assessment – it can be wrong.
timeline.label: History of checked claims
settings.title: Settings
settings.token.label: Access token
settings.token.help: The token from the gateway_token file in the secrets directory. It is stored only in this browser.
settings.providers.title: Active providers
settings.providers.help: The configuration lives on the server; it is only shown here.
settings.providers.error: The providers could not be loaded.
settings.privacy.local: Local mode: only search queries and page fetches leave your own network.
settings.privacy.jev: Jev (TypeSafe) runs in the USA. Depending on the server configuration it continuously receives the latest parts of the conversation (six by default) and claims with source excerpts. Speakers appear there only as letters, but names from the conversation are part of the text.
recording.needsConnection: Recording is possible once the connection is up.
recording.end.recording_limit: Recording ended: the maximum recording time was reached.
recording.end.overloaded: Recording ended: speech recognition could not keep up.
recording.end.budget_exceeded: Recording ended: the daily budget for cloud services is used up. It continues tomorrow.
recording.end.connection_lost: Recording ended: the connection was interrupted.
recording.end.background: Recording ended because the app went to the background. Just start again.
recording.end.microphone_denied: No access to the microphone. Allow it in the browser settings, then start again.
recording.end.microphone_error: The microphone could not be started.
recording.end.rejected: The server rejected the recording. Please start again.
consent.title: Does everyone at the table know?
consent.intro: The phone listens and checks claims while you talk. Tell the others first – and start only if everyone agrees.
consent.cloud: These services on the internet receive audio or text excerpts of the conversation for that:
consent.local: Speech recognition and checking run locally on your own machine. Only evidence search queries and page fetches go to the internet.
consent.error: The active providers could not be loaded. Without this information no recording is possible.
transcript.label: Live transcript
consent.what: What happens to what is said
consent.noRecord: The recording itself is never stored – only text remains. On our side it is gone at the latest a quarter hour after the last word.
show.label: Show
summary.title: One evening, {count} claims
summary.subtitle: The recording itself was never stored. In a quarter hour the text is gone too.
summary.noScores: No points per person. This was about the claims, not about being right.
settings.language.title: Language
settings.language.help: Conversations are still understood in German; only the interface changes here.
